evidence.rationale: The retained packet is derived automatically from a declared guard-expression grammar; 900 assignments per run agree across the primary Pratt parser, an independent shunting-yard parser, the recursive producer, the iterative replay checker, and a C11 oracle. This pass is restricted to the declared grammar and does not certify general C/C++ translation.
The cohort was assembled from published positive and selected-negative class lists before neutral identifiers were assigned.
The package contains 32 selected file changes rather than all eligible changes from a repository-by-time population frame.
Labels were known during cohort construction and before the automatic restricted frontend was finalized.
The implemented comparator is a transparent lexical/syntactic control, not a reproduced strongest published same-budget system.
No pre-cutoff development interval and later sealed candidate interval are represented.
